title: Before Service Spark
description: Create a purposeful welcome arrangement before meal service starts.
goal: Show readiness through a thoughtful setup.

title: Building & Grounds — Spread the Love
description: Show some love to your school's Building & Grounds team! Take a creative photo that celebrates the hardworking custodians and groundskeepers who keep your campus clean, safe, and beautiful.
goal: Capture a heartwarming moment that shows your appreciation for the Building & Grounds team and all they do for your school!

title: Cafeteria Kindness
description: Take a photo of the food samples your team prepared and how you presented them to students.
goal: Share a meaningful moment that shows how a little kindness can brighten someone's day.

title: Farm to School Celebration
description: Show us how your school celebrates Farm to School! Take a photo of your creative displays, decorations, or activities that highlight fresh, locally grown foods.
goal: Capture how your cafeteria brings Farm to School to life and gets students and teacher excited about fresh, healthy foods!

title: Halloween School Spirit
description: Show us how your school celebrates Halloween! Capture a fun photo of the costumes, decorations, or festive activities happening around your campus. Let's see your school's Halloween spirit!
goal: Capture a creative and memorable photo that shows how your school brings Halloween to life outside the cafeteria!

title: Lunch Pop-Up
description: Take lunch outside the cafeteria! Find a cool spot around your school and create a fun, inviting display featuring one of your lunch meals. Get creative with the location and presentation!
goal: Capture an eye-catching photo that makes an everyday school lunch look special in an unexpected location!

title: Menu Display Magic
description:
Show off your school's printed menu! Take a photo of how your cafeteria creatively displays the menu for students to see. Make it colorful, welcoming, and easy to read! 
⭐ Special Note: This challenge will be reviewed very carefully, so make sure your menu display shows creativity, attention to detail, and pride in your cafeteria!
goal: Turn an everyday printed menu into an eye-catching display that gets students excited about what's being served!

title: Sunrise with the Cafeteria Crew
description: Rise and shine! Capture a beautiful morning sunrise with your cafeteria team or a delicious breakfast display. Get creative with the morning light and show us how your school starts the day!
goal: Capture a memorable sunrise that celebrates the early mornings and hard work of your cafeteria team!

title: Supper Success
description: Show off your supper program and the after school staff who make it happen! Gather your after-school team for a fun photo.
goal: Capture a creative team photo that celebrates the hard work and teamwork behind a successful supper program!

title: Team Thank You
description: Show us how your school appreciates its cafeteria team! Take a photo of thank-you notes, student artwork, or messages of appreciation displayed on your kitchen wall.
goal: Capture a heartwarming display that shows how much your school values its cafeteria team!
